plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Barbering Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published June 2, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7814/PublishedPdf). Official Total Units: 32; this seed = 2 + 15 + 15 = 32 units. Semester sums verified against the map's 2 / 15 / 15 headers. In-plan prereqs: BAR 115 and BAR 117 require BAR 100 with a grade of 'P' (pass); BAR 135 and BAR 137 require BAR 100, 115, and 117 with grades of 'C' or better. Corequisites (documented, not modeled as prereqs): BAR 115 with BAR 117; BAR 117 with BAR 115; BAR 135 with BAR 137; BAR 137 with BAR 135 — both pairs are taken together in the same semester. Certificate of Achievement requirements: grade of 'C' or better in each major course. Barbering, Business & Industry Meta Majors. Distinct from the Barbering A.S. degrees (maps 7807, 7808). tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
